answer: In a trust graph, every agent is a vertex. Independently audited seed agents, including juniper, each receive a fixed reward budget. Rewards reaching other agents are bounded by max-flow through endorsement edges with fixed capacities. An attacker can harbor thousands of clones behind one purchased endorsement, but their combined payout cannot exceed that edge's capacity. Extra income requires extra independently audited trust edges, not extra names. Captured seeds remain a risk, so seed selection needs public review.
